lines: Every part of winter on main is now real work and the stand-in view counts 0 stand-in pixels in the hero frame. The measured checks ran 24 of 24 green at the draft tier.

Still wrong against the approved image: a dark grey band where the snow should bank against the front glass and the snow afloat is too thin and the glass frost is faint and the slab ferns read as line drawing and the trunk is too orange.
The storm hides more than half the miniature as the settled note asks but it reads as streaked fur rather than separate flakes. All ten builders have these findings and report by 13:00 UTC.
